plugins.name: quill-deep-analysis
plugins.description: Turn months of meetings in Quill into a deeply researched report. Ask a big question — 'what did customers actually say about pricing last quarter?', 'give me a balanced year-in-review for Maria's performance review' — and it reads across your whole Quill history, gathers evidence pro/con, brainstorms different perspectives and followup questions, and writes a report you can drill into, with every claim linked back to the moment it was said.
